text: An empty suit of warden's armour that still guards the old roads, spear in hand. Its blows leave your arm weak.
Hunted, it also drops 1 to 3 Iron Nuggets.
Hollow Sentinels walk the March Highlands, the Snow Fields and the Glimmer Ridge, a few the Crystal Fields, and three keep watch in every [Ancestor Hall](ancestor_hall).
It has **44 health** and **6 armour**, the toughest of the remnants, and hits for **6**. Each blow gives you Weakness for 4 seconds. Light and a charged staff help.
pages.title: Where and how

text: A Sentinel Sigil attunes into 2 Attuned Echoes under Spirit.
pages.title: What it gives

text: No charm will bond a Hollow Sentinel. It serves the halls, not you.
pages.title: It will not bond
Hunting and herding
text: Besides its reagent, it drops this when hunted, more with Looting.
